newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Daehan buys 28,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Daehan buys 28,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd said on Friday it bought 28,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Mitsui and Co Ltd.
A Daehan official said shipment was set for April 10-May 10 to the western port of Inchon.

The official said the total amount would be split into four positions -- 14,200 tonnes of western white/soft white, 1,000 tonnes of western white (club minimum 15 percent), 3,300 tonnes of hard red winter (protein minimum 11.5 percent), and 9,500 tonnes of dark northern spring (protein minimum 14 percent).
